questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A car starting from rest accelerates uniformly and reaches a speed of 20 m s⁻¹ in 5 s. The distance covered in this time is:
questions.explanation: a = (20 - 0)/5 = 4 m s⁻². Then s = ut + ½at² = 0 + ½ × 4 × 25 = 50 m, which also equals average velocity 10 m s⁻¹ times 5 s.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 2: Motion in a Straight Line

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The Young's modulus of a perfectly rigid body is:
questions.explanation: Y = stress/strain. A perfectly rigid body suffers no strain whatever the stress, so the ratio tends to infinity.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 8: Mechanical Properties of Solids

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In Bohr's model of the hydrogen atom, the radius of the nth orbit is proportional to:
questions.explanation: rₙ = 0.529 n²/Z angstrom, so the radius grows as n², while the energy varies as -13.6/n² eV.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following sets of quantum numbers is NOT permitted?
questions.explanation: The azimuthal quantum number can only take values from 0 to (n - 1), so l = 3 is impossible when n = 3.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 2: Structure of Atom

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: When potassium permanganate acts as an oxidising agent in acidic medium, the oxidation state of manganese changes from +7 to:
questions.explanation: In acidic medium MnO₄⁻ accepts five electrons to give the almost colourless Mn²⁺. In neutral or faintly alkaline medium it stops at MnO₂ with Mn in +4.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 4: The d- and f-Block Elements

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Benzene prefers electrophilic substitution over addition reactions because:
options: Substitution preserves the stable delocalised pi electron system
Its carbon atoms are sp³ hybridised
questions.explanation: Addition would destroy the aromatic sextet and its large resonance stabilisation, so benzene reacts by substitution, which keeps the ring aromatic.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The respiratory quotient (RQ) when fats are used as the respiratory substrate is:
questions.explanation: Fats are poor in oxygen, so more O₂ is consumed than CO₂ released and RQ falls below 1. For carbohydrates RQ is 1 and for organic acids it exceeds 1.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 12: Respiration in Plants

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Apomixis in flowering plants refers to:
options: Germination of pollen on the stigma
questions.explanation: Apomictic seeds are genetically identical to the mother plant, which is why the trait is valuable for keeping hybrid vigour stable across generations.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 1: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The corpus luteum formed after ovulation mainly secretes:
questions.explanation: Progesterone from the corpus luteum keeps the endometrium ready for implantation; if pregnancy does not occur the corpus luteum degenerates and menstruation follows.

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The resting membrane potential of a neuron is maintained mainly by:
options: Opening of voltage gated sodium channels
questions.explanation: The pump drives three Na⁺ out for every two K⁺ in, keeping the inside negative at about -70 mV. Sodium channels open only during an action potential.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 18: Neural Control and Coordination
